# Test fixtures

Minimal sample files for integration tests. Generated by `scripts/generate-fixtures.ts`.

| File | Description | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `sample.png` | 1×1 red pixel, 8-bit RGB PNG (69 B) | Generated programmatically with `zlib` |
| `sample.jpg` | 1×1 red pixel, baseline JPEG (225 B) | Generated via `ffmpeg` |
| `sample.webp` | 1×1 red pixel, VP8 lossy (68 B) | Generated via `ffmpeg -c:v libwebp` |
| `sample.gif` | 2×2 red, 2-frame GIF (853 B) | Generated via `ffmpeg` |
| `sample-video.mp4` | 2×2 red, 10-frame H.264 MP4 (1.8 KB) | Generated via `ffmpeg -c:v libx264` |

## Regenerating

```bash
bun run scripts/generate-fixtures.ts
```

Requires `ffmpeg` on `PATH` (with `libx264` and `libwebp` support).

## Adding new fixtures

1. Add the generation command to `scripts/generate-fixtures.ts`
2. Run `bun run scripts/generate-fixtures.ts`
3. Update this table
